title: Separated affine function-field charts give a closed immersion
statement: Under the hypotheses of lem-sc-separated-affine-function-field-surjective, the spectrum map induced by the canonical tensor-product map from Γ(X,U) ⊗_ℤ O_{X,x} to X.functionField is a closed immersion.

proof.text: Construct the pullback of the diagonal of the separated scheme along the two affine charts, identify the pullback with Spec of the function field using the one-dimensional local calculation, and transport the resulting closed immersion through the affine spectrum identifications.

lean.statement:
theorem Scheme.isClosedImmersion_specMap_tensor_functionField
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsIntegral X]
    [hsep : X.IsSeparated]
    (U : X.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U) [hUn : Nonempty U]
    (x : X) (hx : x ∉ U)
    [IsNoetherianRing (X.presheaf.stalk x)]
    (hdim : ringKrullDim (X.presheaf.stalk x) = 1) :
    let A : Type u := Γ(X, U)
    let B : Type u := X.presheaf.stalk x
    let K : Type u := X.functionField
    let φ : TensorProduct ℤ A B →ₐ[ℤ] K :=
      Algebra.TensorProduct.lift
        (X.germToFunctionField U).hom.toIntAlgHom
        (algebraMap B K).toIntAlgHom
        (fun _ _ => Commute.all _ _)
    IsClosedImmersion (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ.toRingHom))
